verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a hosted commerce platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region or residency selection. The ships_to/ships_from catalog filters concern product shipping, and the local UCP profile is an identity file; neither is a data-residency control, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
